cohort: The study included 93 cases (55 asymptomatic, 38 symptomatic) of congenital cytomegalovirus (cCMV) infection followed between August 2010 and August 2022.
finding: The median baseline blood viral load in symptomatic cCMV infection was significantly higher than that in asymptomatic cCMV infection, although there was no difference in median viral clearance times between these groups or between different antiviral treatment durations.
followup_time: approximately 90 days (for viral clearance times), with cases followed between August 2010 and August 2022
